messages:
rhea: Kicking off staged rollout of 'surge-smoother-v2' to prod GPU pools. Canary numbers look good: p50 ~9% down, p99 ~18% down, token cost ~6% lower on conversational traces. Rolling cautiously. :rocket:

deploy-bot: canary summary (canary-5 -> prod):
- p50: 101ms -> 92ms (-8.9%)
- p99: 480ms -> 394ms (-17.9%)
- token unit $: $0.0096 -> $0.0090 (-6.3%)
- error rate: 0.016% -> 0.017% (no alerts)

omar: what changed? scheduler or cache tweaks?

rhea: small combo of changes: 1) adaptive surge coalescer that merges tiny bursts without increasing tail latency, 2) priority-aware KV prefetch that favors hot prefixes under burst, 3) conservative timebox tuning to protect p99. No model or weight changes.

sre: rollback plan and opt-out for tenants?

rhea: feature-flag `runtime.surge_smoother_v2` (per-pool). Rollback: `POST /release/flags/runtime.surge_smoother_v2/disable` with body '{"pool":"<pool>"}'. Tenant opt-out: `runtime.disable_surge_smoother=true`. Runbook: https://go/redwood/runbooks/surge-smoother.

claire: dropping the quick check we used in canary for pool owners:
```
# compare p99 per pool between canary snapshot and prod
python infra/checks.py --metric p99_latency --from canary-5 --to prod --group pool --short
```

metrics-bot: posting dash: https://metrics.redwood/internal/dashboards/surge-smoother (internal)

omar: can someone draft a one-line for ops + CS with opt-out link?

rhea: Draft: "Deployed surge-smoother-v2: p50 -9%, p99 -18%, token cost -6%. Tenant opt-out: runtime.disable_surge_smoother=true. Runbook: https://go/redwood/runbooks/surge-smoother" :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: feature `runtime.surge_smoother_v2` enabled on pools: gpu-us-west-1a, gpu-eu-central-1b. Rolling to remaining pools in 30m if green.

sre: I'll watch the 5m windows and add automated rollback triggers for p99 uplift > 15% or error-rate delta > 0.04%.

rhea: thanks all  kudos to coalescer + prefetch teams. Will post a short follow-up with batch-size distribution and remote-hit ratio charts later. :party_parrot:
